rationale: A cross-file transfer with consistent renaming has one identifiable Type-2 parent; repeated small statements must not replace that coherent move.

required.from: if (left) { int marker = 0; transferLeft(); int marker = 0; }
required.to: if (right) { int marker = 0; transferRight(); int marker = 0; }
